summary: Return product_id and product_name for products that were sold in the interval 2019-01-01 to 2019-03-31 inclusive and were never sold outside that interval.
inputFormat: Product(product_id, product_name, unit_price); Sales(seller_id, product_id, buyer_id, sale_date, quantity, price); sale_date is a date.
outputFormat: Columns product_id and product_name; one row per qualifying product.
edgeRules: A product with no sales does not qualify. Interval is inclusive at both ends.
